## Quality standards

- Transform only the validated current-flow source artifact. Do not add, correct, or remove test content.
- Preserve every source test case once, keep the 14 required fields in the workbook contract, and leave unsupported fields blank.
- Verify the workbook opens, worksheet name and headers match the contract, and exported row count matches the source case count.
- Report the output path, row count, and verification result. Report any parse or export limitation instead of claiming a complete export.
- Do not claim requirement coverage or quality approval; QualitySentinel owns those judgments.
